QuestInfo.name: The Thief's Next Journey
QuestInfo.0: Having reached level 30 and mastered the way of the Rogue, I feel the urge to learn more.
QuestInfo.1: Does #b#p411##k of #b#m10003000##k have even greater lessons to teach me?
QuestInfo.2: #b#p411##k said that if I can pass his test, he'll gladly teach me more. I'm no longer the weakling I once was, but hearing that I still have to face a trial makes me a bit nervous.

0.0: Finally, I reached level 30! It hasn't been easy, but now I'm confident I can stand as a true Rogue who won't lose to anyone. Still... Is this really enough? The world is vast, and I find myself wanting to learn more.
0.1: I should probably visit #b#p411##k in #b#m10003000##k again. He might be able to teach me even greater things.

1.0: Hmmm... You seem to have gotten a whole lot stronger. You got rid of your old, weak self and look much more like a Thief now.
1.1: No need for a long explanation. You want to know more about the deeper, darker world, don't you? Seeing someone like you makes me feel fired up for the first time in a while... heh.
